pageSubtitle: Explore donor-level functional data across selected biological contexts using interactive filtering and visualization.
Designed for rapid hypothesis generation, transparent cohort review, and future agent-assisted interpretation.

step1.title: Interactive Cohort Filtering
step1.titleInfo: Use metadata and range filters to define the analysis cohort before exploring functional signals.

step2.title: Functional feature plots
step2.titleInfo: Inspect response trajectories across stimulation windows for the currently filtered donors.
step2.subtitle: Time-series / stimulation response
step2.subtitleInfo: This panel emphasizes temporal dynamics, donor variability, and mean trend under stimulation.
step2.responseTypeInfo: Switch analytes to compare secretion profiles (e.g., INS, GCG, SST) under the same cohort filter.

step3.title: Explore trait distribution
step3.titleInfo: Review trait-level distribution changes after cohort filtering to identify outliers and subgroup shifts.

step4.title: Inspect donor metadata
step4.titleInfo: Audit donor-level rows and export the filtered table for downstream analysis.

rightPanel.aboutInfo: Background context for the source, status, and interpretation of functional data.
rightPanel.aboutBody: The functional data shown here were generated by the Human Pancreas Analysis Program (HPAP) and the Human Islet Phenotyping Program (HIPP) of the Integrated Islet Isolation Program (IIDP) using a Vanderbilt-developed islet phenotyping pipeline shared with both HPAP and HIPP. These data capture human islet insulin or glucagon secretion in response to physiological and pharmacological stimuli over time and are displayed with PanKgraph-linked donor context. The HPAP dataset has not yet been published; the HIPP data has been published (PMID: 39605606). The underlying pipeline has been used since 2013 and is documented in prior publications, including PMID: 38049589, 35642629, 34870058, 33844836, 34428183, 32352931, 30507613, 29669939, 29514095.
rightPanel.importantBody: This tool supports interactive filtering and visualization of islet functional data. Formal statistical conclusions should be based on the corresponding analyses published in PMID: 42120367
